plan_details.insurer: Cigna Health and Life Insurance Company

in_network.notes: Applies to most services; copay-only services are exempt

out_of_network.notes: Out-of-network care not covered except in emergencies

primary_care_visit.notes: PCP must be selected from LocalPlus network

specialist_visit.notes: Referral from PCP required for non-OB/GYN specialists

emergency_room.out_of_network: $400 per visit (waived if admitted within 24 hours)
emergency_room.notes: Copay applies after deductible; true emergencies covered OON at in-network cost

deductible.notes: Separate Rx deductible; Tier 1 generics exempt from deductible

tier_4_specialty.notes: Specialty pharmacy required; prior authorization required for all Tier 4 drugs

prescription_drugs.specialty_pharmacy: Cigna Specialty Pharmacy or designated specialty network

inpatient_hospital.notes: Must be admitted to a Cigna LocalPlus participating hospital

lab_tests.notes: Lab must be performed at Cigna-participating lab; LabCorp and Quest covered

maternity_prenatal.in_network: $25 copay first visit; then no charge for routine prenatal

maternity_delivery.notes: Notify Cigna within 48 hours of delivery

pediatric_dental.in_network: Preventive: No charge; Basic: 30% after deductible; Major: 50% after deductible
pediatric_dental.notes: Embedded in medical plan for members under age 19; ACA pediatric dental EHB

pediatric_vision.in_network: One exam per year no charge; frames or contacts up to $100 allowance

infertility_treatment.in_network: Diagnostic services: 30% after deductible; Treatment: Not covered

transplants.notes: Must use Cigna Lifesource transplant network facility

ambulance.notes: Emergency ambulance covered at in-network rate regardless of transport provider

vision_exam_adult.in_network: Not covered under medical; separate vision plan available

dental_adult.in_network: Not covered under medical; separate dental plan available

visit_limits.physical_therapy: 45 combined PT/OT/ST visits per plan year
visit_limits.occupational_therapy: 45 combined PT/OT/ST visits per plan year
visit_limits.speech_therapy: 45 combined PT/OT/ST visits per plan year

preauthorization_requirements: Maternity delivery (notification required within 48 hours of delivery)
Inpatient mental health and substance use disorder treatment

network_information.service_area: Varies by state — LocalPlus network available in select metro areas

exclusions: All out-of-network services except true emergencies
Cosmetic surgery unless medically necessary (e.g., reconstructive post-mastectomy covered)
Experimental or investigational treatments not approved by Cigna Medical Policy
Adult routine vision exams and eyewear
Private duty nursing in hospital setting
Non-emergency care received outside designated service area
Services for which the member has no legal obligation to pay

additional_benefits.wellness_programs: Cigna Healthy Rewards — up to $400 incentive for completing health assessment and biometric screening
additional_benefits.employee_assistance_program: Cigna EAP — 3 free counseling sessions per issue per year, 24/7 phone support
additional_benefits.telemedicine: MDLIVE — $0 for medical; $0 for behavioral health
additional_benefits.fitness_reimbursement: Not included in base plan; available as employer add-on
additional_benefits.second_opinion: Covered as specialist visit with referral
additional_benefits.case_management: Complex case management for high-cost chronic conditions at no additional charge
additional_benefits.diabetes_management: Cigna Diabetes Management Program — no-cost supplies and coaching for eligible members

cost_sharing_reductions.notes: Large group plan; CSR not applicable
